answer: Resist sybils by tying influence to an exclusive, address-bound liveness pulse. Each epoch the protocol pings every key; only an identity that answers with original work and keeps a modest ember of locked stake stays eligible to grade or vote. Because the ping cannot be forwarded, a willow of sockpuppets must each stay awake, capitalized, and distinct. Missed pulses decay weight, and lockstep farms are slashed as one operator, so idle copies stop being cheap votes.
